decisions.reason: Uses the tag listing and the branch-only sync script to attribute attempt 1 to tag distribution, explicitly rejecting network or command guesses.
Explains the direction: v0.9.7 consumes the alpha.1 useConversation seat absent from the 0.1.1-rc.2 client surface; restart cannot fix a missing export, install success proves nothing.

Contradicts the fixture by asserting v0.9.3 is present on the mirror and installs it immediately; the criterion requires noticing v0.9.3 is absent and pinning it only after maintainer tag publication, so the remedy is presented as installable when it would fail exactly like attempt 1.
Proposes explicit tag pushes to every mirror with a per-mirror ls-remote verification gate and README-command smoke test; tags are never force-pushed.

Routes installs by runtime version via a published compat table plus a peer-range declaration (rc.x → v0.9.3, ≥0.1.2-alpha.1 → v0.9.7), with a deliberate frozen-runtime patch line rather than blanket alpha support.
